The '''Model 38''' was one of the most popular models of [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|Slugthrower rifle]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The weapons were primarily used by [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]], [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Each rifle was unique and adjusted to its owner.
